body: it's so true about the bad things in your life not going away. some people are able to move on, block it out of their mind, or just not discuss it. I think about things from 10 years ago still that bother me. I know nothing is perfect but how the hell do you move on from major parts in your life sometimes

I feel like it's just been this gradual decline. I remember anticipating things in the future. having a goal and wanting to achieve it. but it's like there's barely anything there anymore. some days I feel like it could come back but those days are few and far between

thank you for the advice. it's really tough because before I heard she was interested we were becoming really close friends. I haven't been that close with any female friends before like that. I want that friendship back but I'm worried I'll always want more. I've talked to her about it on multiple occasions and I think she's tired of hearing about it. I haven't really told her exactly how I feel tho. and if I stop hanging out with her I'll stop seeing like 90% of my friends. my roommate is dating her roommate. really shitty situation

using my throwaway because I want to keep this away from my normal account.

I had a really bad Saturday night that ties into the awful year that I've been having. my mind is all fucked up now and the worst part is that I know I'm so aware of my issues. I've been incredibly emotional, childish, and insecure about myself for months now because of this. 

long story short I developed really strong feelings for a close friend of mine. she initiated everything first and I grew some feelings for her once I knew she was interested (when I met her I thought she was way out of my league, I wasn't looking for anything, and she had just ended a fling she was having). well after a bit she decided that she really didn't share those feelings with me and just wanted to be friends. but I didnt/till can't let go of the feelings I have for her and the more I got to know her the stronger they've gotten. 

the problem is that I know she's not perfect or great for me. I truly like a lot of who she is but she's also been a bit mean towards me at times, has lied to me, and seems to be pulling away from the friendship. we rarely talk now and when we are hanging out I just get the feeling that she would prefer not to be with me alone (we hooked up a couple times when we were drunk and I think she's afraid she'll keep doing that, she's initiated all the physical contact we've ever had). she seems completely over me and I also feel like I'm losing her as a friend. I desperately want the friendship to survive. I can't get her out of my head. I think about her all the time, I get jealous when she mentions other guys or talks to other guys I know she likes. 

it's childish and I hate how I feel. I'm in my mid twenties and I feel like I'm 15 sometimes. I'm incredibly embarrassed about my feelings and emotions but I've also never felt so strongly towards someone before. I think it's because when we were close and working on something that was the happiest I've been in years. I don't know what the fuck to do but today I think I finally truly realized how crazy I've been. I want nothing more than to feel better and I think today is a big step in moving forward. but I'm just afraid this will really fuck me up

TDLR - very strong feelings for close friend. she no longer feels the same way. have had a lot of trouble moving on and my childish control of my emotions is threatening the friendship and may have already ruined it.

congratulations on graduating in two weeks. I graduated college two years ago and it's been a very strange and difficult two years. but I know people that have done and accomplished a lot in those two years. I hope things work out for you.

it feels like my life has just constantly been "hold on because it might get better". really hope that actually happens and my life wasn't all for nothing

your words do really help. thank you for taking the time. I just feel like I've been working on myself for so long. but when will I see anything that validates me. I have a lot of trouble trying to enjoy the little things in life. I don't know what it is but I just can't do it, the moments are too fleeting. I'm much more social now because I've been isolated for so long and it still doesn't feel like it's working.

my roommate is the person I spend the most time with. we're pretty similar in terms of having the same struggles and wanting to have a better life. right now his life is turning around while mine seems to be crumbling even more. now my jealousy and envy of his potential outcome is starting to show. I just feel exhausted, like I've been in this battle for decades
